study: E5 (acceptance-odds add-on to E4b; Qwen2.5-0.5B adapters of E4b, read-only)

e5a.order_rule: pairs processed in numpy default_rng(order_seed).permutation(91) order of populations_e4b.json P; if the deadline stops the run, the completed prefix is the pre-registered random subset
e5a.selection: per pair and method: first max of mean normalized held-out score (1,000 held-out TRAIN examples per task) in grid order; one eval-set evaluation at the selected config (e3.run unmodified)

decision.test: scipy.stats.wilcoxon(g, zero_method='wilcox', alternative='greater') on per-pair gains g = score_m - score_TA (p = 1 if all g == 0)
decision.rule: m beats TA iff mean(g) >= +0.005 AND Holm-adjusted Wilcoxon p < 0.05
decision.also_reported: E3 sign-flip permutation test (10,000, one-sided) with Holm, task-block bootstrap 95% CI (2,000), W/T/L, median, boundary rates

e5b.selection: first max of held-out normalized score over lambda_all (ties -> smaller lambda)
e5b.analysis: e4b_analysis.pop_stats (unmodified) with D replaced by D_ext; H1 (O_A) / H2 (tv_cosine); rule applied DESCRIPTIVELY as a sensitivity; does not replace the E4b primary verdict
